h: Burton, brewing and the High Street
p: Burton-on-Trent is famous for one thing above all, and that's beer. The town's brewing heritage is everywhere, from the old brewery buildings to the smell of malt that still drifts across town some days, and it's also where Marmite is made.

The High Street runs close to the River Trent, and the Washlands, the green riverside parkland on the edge of the centre, make for a pleasant stroll if you want some fresh air. Admiral is an 18+ adult gaming centre rather than a family day out, so plan the rest of the trip around the shops at Coopers Square and the town's pubs and cafés. Burton Albion fans will know the town gets busier on home match days.
